title: Print a greeting
summary: Erlang: Print a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: io:format writes output. ~n starts a new line. The module exports main so the command can call it.

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
io:format reads the format string. ~n starts a newline after the greeting.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The module name lesson must match lesson.erl.
